title: Review-copy watermark on the launch film
caption: The Magnifito launch film as a client review copy: a dark banner reading "REVIEW COPY" with the reviewer's name, in white text sized for the 1080p frame, is burned into the top-right corner of every frame, so a shared cut cannot pass as the final. The banner is as wide as its text.
prompt: Make a review copy of ../videos/01-branded-promo.mp4 for the client: burn in a "REVIEW COPY" watermark with the reviewer name "Magnifito client" in the top-right corner, clear of the titles. Keep the sound.
commands: mgvideo watermark ../videos/01-branded-promo.mp4 --text 'REVIEW COPY' --reviewer 'Magnifito client' --position top_right --font-size 28 --color '#FFFFFF' --opacity 0.75 --out work/review-copy.mp4
credits: Video and sound: 01-branded-promo from this showcase (Geist typeface, OFL-1.1; sound effects synthesized by mgvideo sfx)
